portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.intro: Here are some of my projects.
portfolio.description.symploqueCrm: Custom full-stack CRM SaaS with authentication, PostgreSQL (Neon), and premium UI.
portfolio.description.critertec: Educational and technological agency. Designing and implementing innovative digital solutions.
portfolio.description.humanizar: Ecosystem of commercial platforms, SaaS, and business tools.
portfolio.description.indie: Video game development and immersive experiences.
portfolio.description.autoLogic: Natural language to executable formal logic with no AI, using rule-based NLP only (npm @stevenvo780/autologic): 11 logic profiles plus a local SLM fine-tuning layer. A natural companion to ST.
portfolio.description.mcpDelegateAgents: Swarm-style MCP server delegating tasks to a swarm of local LLMs with Ollama (planner → workers → reviewer).
portfolio.description.mcpAgents: Full MCP Server supporting OpenAI/GPT-4o for integrated autonomy.
portfolio.description.convertPdfToMarkdo: PDF/DOCX/PPTX → Markdown converter with GPU-accelerated Surya OCR; decoupled API + GPU worker + frontend architecture (FastAPI).
portfolio.description.jarvisIaV2: Local multimodal assistant: GPU LLMs (vLLM/CUDA), hybrid RAG (ChromaDB + BGE-M3 + BM25), voice (Whisper/TTS), Docker-packaged.
portfolio.description.fiarFront: Robust modern web application for comprehensive financial credit management.
portfolio.description.fiarApi: Fintech backend in NestJS + TypeORM + PostgreSQL: credit, portfolio, and recurring-payment management (Mercado Pago).
portfolio.description.fiarBlockchain: Exploratory Smart Contracts component for the FIAR ecosystem.
portfolio.description.graf: Multi-store e-commerce / order-management platform: catalog, real-time inventory, checkout, and Wompi gateway. NestJS + TypeORM + PostgreSQL + Next.js. In production.
portfolio.description.sinergiaPos: Point-of-sale with DIAN e-invoicing, cash register, taxes, and multiple payment gateways (Mercado Pago/Wompi). NestJS + React 18 offline PWA. In production.
portfolio.description.agora: Distributed AI-agent SaaS platform in production: 7 services, ~150 tools, and ~30 Docker workers, operated for under $1/month. Covers architecture, backend, AI, frontend, and DevOps.
portfolio.description.cristinaCms: Editorial CMS in Next.js 16 (RSC + Server Actions) + Neon Postgres + auth. In production.
portfolio.description.emw: WhatsApp Business mass-messaging automation platform (NestJS + MySQL + Redis).
portfolio.description.gcpBucketSync: Dashboard and API (FastAPI) for Google Cloud Storage sync and monitoring, with real-time metrics (WebSockets).
portfolio.description.ultimateTerminal: Distributed remote terminal-control system (Nexus/Worker): .deb packages, systemd, tag-based CI/CD, and Docker.
portfolio.description.educacionCooperati: Agora frontend source (Next.js 15 + React 18 + Redux): MDX document editor, web terminal (xterm.js), knowledge graph, and AI-agent chat. Origin of the knowledge-management ecosystem.
portfolio.description.agoraBackend: Agentic AI backend in Express/TypeScript deployed on Cloud Run: tool orchestration, time-unlimited streaming, and agent execution. The service core of the Agora ecosystem.
portfolio.description.helenikos: University platform for learning Ancient Greek (Next.js 15 + TypeScript + Tailwind): morphological analyzer, etymological dictionary, annotated corpus, and student/teacher/admin role system with progress tracking.
portfolio.description.warehouseManagemen: Full-stack warehouse management system (React 19 + TypeScript + Firebase + Vite): multi-warehouse inventory, orders, role-based authentication, and real-time charting analytics.
portfolio.description.localLlmChat: Chat app over quantized LLMs (GGUF) run with llama-cpp-python on NVIDIA GPU: FastAPI backend, multi-GPU VRAM management, and Qwen2.5, Llama 3.1, Gemma 2, and DeepSeek-R1 models.
portfolio.description.stLanguage: Executable formal-logic language (npm @stevenvo780/st-lang): a DSL with 30+ logic profiles, a custom SAT solver (CDCL), type theory (MLTT), and 6000+ tests. The most ambitious project in the portfolio; integrated into the Agora agent.
portfolio.description.estructurasPreonto: Computational research (doctoral thesis): an ABM+ODE simulation engine with an ablative validation protocol (EDI) over 40 cases spanning 30 orders of spatial and temporal magnitude. Live app.
portfolio.description.tesisJacob: ABM+ODE engine to measure the 'operational closure' of hyperobjects (climate, epidemics, deforestation) across 29 cases, with an original EDI metric and vectorized permutation tests.
portfolio.description.fenomenologiaUrban: City simulation (Medellín) combining ABM, GPU PDE, and deep reinforcement learning (PyTorch) with Husserlian and Foucauldian philosophical analysis.
portfolio.description.unaCartaParaIsaSim: Artificial-life engine: ABM with 30+ subsystems and RAG over 227k lines of real emotional corpus feeding agent culture and emotions; Phaser 3 rendering and a 50 Hz WebSocket backend.
portfolio.description.cartaParaIsa: Simulated world integrating ABM, PDE, and RAG over 227k lines of real chat, with emotional-bonding mechanics between autonomous agents.
portfolio.description.unMundoParaIsa: Artificial-life engine with state machines and goal planning, diffusion/reaction fields, an internal economy, and 50 Hz WebSocket synchronization.
portfolio.description.redesNeuronalesFil: Interactive presentation with live simulations (TensorFlow.js, Three.js, and the Game of Life) bridging neural networks with philosophy of mind and neuroscience.
portfolio.description.logicEducation: Educational platform to teach formal logic interactively, built on top of the ST language ecosystem.
portfolio.description.hinton: Representations of the consciousness problem and neural networks inspired by Hinton.
portfolio.description.cafeteriaDelCaosFr: New optimized version of the debate social network.
portfolio.description.duoEterno: Interactive laboratory of autopoiesis and artificial life based on co-evolution.
portfolio.description.unaCartaParaIsa: Narrative-driven autonomous ecosystem with multiple complex systems.
portfolio.description.hiperObjetoSimulac: 20+ hybrid simulations (ABM+ODE+SEIR) to computationally validate the philosophical theory of the hyperobject, using the EDI metric.
